candidates.title: Align runtime installation, invocation, discovery, and reload guidance
candidates.target_intent: install Agent Skills in Codex, Claude Code, or Cursor
candidates.original_contribution: Reconcile current official discovery locations with actual output from Slashskills' generated install commands and explain capability limits.
candidates.next_action: Compare /guides/cursor Search Console clicks, impressions, CTR, position, and visible Cursor-intent query coverage after 14 and 28 complete days from the 2026-09-01 deployment.
candidates.editorial_note: The expanded /guides/cursor content, self-canonical, indexability, and live production markers were re-verified on 2026-09-02. Do not infer success before the measurement windows.

candidates.title: Controlled cross-runtime evaluation of one representative skill
candidates.target_intent: Agent Skills compatibility across Codex Claude Code Cursor
candidates.original_contribution: Run the same declared task and rubric in each runtime, publish method, artifacts, failures, versions and limitations.
candidates.next_action: Choose a representative skill and preserve complete runs/tool events in all three runtimes; strengthen /compatibility before considering a new URL.

candidates.title: Define portable-core versus runtime-extension frontmatter policy
candidates.target_intent: portable Agent Skills frontmatter across runtimes
candidates.original_contribution: Test standard, Cursor-extended, Claude-extended, and OpenAI metadata fixtures against the Slashskills validator and runtime behavior.
candidates.next_action: Execute the four-fixture matrix in the research brief, then decide whether findings only update /skill-creator and /compatibility or earn a distinct guide.
candidates.editorial_note: Research is approved; a new article is not. Default outcome is an existing-page update. A separate URL requires surprising incompatibilities or a reusable adapter pattern that existing pages cannot answer cleanly.

candidates.title: Measure Codex behavior when installed skills exceed the initial catalog budget
candidates.target_intent: Codex too many Agent Skills description truncation omission
candidates.original_contribution: Use Slashskills and deterministic synthetic packages to measure description shortening, omission order, warnings, and explicit versus implicit selection at 10, 25, 50, and 100 installed skills.
candidates.next_action: Complete repository and production QA for the measured /guides/codex and /skill-creator updates, then record the existing-page publication without creating a new URL.
candidates.editorial_note: Codex 0.152.1 kept all 209 skills visible in the final capture but compressed 100 project descriptions to 40–44 characters. Front-loaded implicit discovery succeeded 3/3; an opaque rear trigger shortened away succeeded 1/3. Treat the behavioral sample as directional and do not claim an omission threshold.

candidates.title: Explain why allowed-tools is not a portable safety guarantee
candidates.original_contribution: Distinguish requested capability, pre-approval, restriction, and actual runtime sandbox enforcement using validator and controlled runtime evidence.
candidates.next_action: Add harmless adversarial fixtures for compound-command permission rules, plugin component symlinks, managed-MCP reconnect, and credential cleanup; document runtime semantics only after controlled verification.
candidates.editorial_note: Claude Code 2.1.257 fixed several relevant trust-boundary failures on 2026-09-01. This is a high ecosystem signal but remains an existing-page update candidate until owned reproduction establishes affected behavior.

candidates.title: Evidence-backed teardown of a high-value skill package
candidates.target_intent: how to structure a reliable Agent Skill

candidates.next_action: First test whether /skill-creator already satisfies the intent; prefer strengthening it over a new URL.

candidates.title: Translate Agent Skills specification changes into migration consequences
candidates.original_contribution: Diff the standard against all 33 packages and report concrete validation or compatibility consequences.
candidates.next_action: Activate only when an authoritative standard change creates a real repository delta.

candidates.title: Translate MCP 2026-07-28 into tested cross-client migration consequences
candidates.target_intent: MCP 2026-07-28 migration compatibility across Codex Claude Code Cursor
candidates.original_contribution: Test one legacy and one current MCP server across the three clients, including discovery fallback, initialization, subscriptions, authorization, structured errors, and SDK version support.
candidates.next_action: Keep on the high-priority watchlist; promote to a research brief only after choosing a representative MCP server and defining a versioned compatibility fixture.
